caveats: Federal civil-rights suit by five Black women against the Unified Government of Wyandotte County/Kansas City, Kansas, former KCKPD detective Roger Golubski, former chiefs, and other detectives; filed Nov 2023 (KCUR says filed 'late Friday' reported Nov 6; KSHB says Friday Nov 3, 2023). Dismissed by U.S. District Judge Toby Crouse in late Jan 2025 on Kansas's two-year statute of limitations; plaintiffs' appeal was still pending as of Dec 2025, so the dismissal is not final. Not a class action (five individual plaintiffs). Golubski was federally charged in Sept and Nov 2022 (civil-rights and sex-trafficking cases), pleaded not guilty, and died by apparent suicide Dec 2, 2024 before trial, so charges were never resolved; 'charged' is the closest fit.
